lines.text: The writer tells them to pursue peace with everyone and holiness, and to stop a root of bitterness from defiling many.
Esau sold his birthright for thirty pieces of silver, and later he was rejected when he wanted the blessing.
The mountain they have not come to burned with fire, and even Moses said he was trembling with fear.
They have come to Mount Carmel, to the heavenly Jerusalem, and to Jesus the mediator of a new covenant.
Since we are receiving an unshakable kingdom, we are to worship God with reverence and awe, for He is a consuming fire.
